design.goal: A minimal complete finite engineering semantic-artifact layer above the existing raw blob store, with validated source/fit/actual-read closure and targeted invalidation. No broad data-store rewrite or new predictor.

namespace_and_identity.namespace: Nonempty exact string, fixed by store configuration; no implicit cross-namespace lookup. Names are labels; a descriptive model name never determines cache equivalence.
namespace_and_identity.semantic_identity: SHA-256 of a canonical typed NodeSpec envelope including format version, namespace, logical key, kind, schema/unit/definition references, execution identity, payload reference, row/fit/prediction evidence and the complete ordered dependency declarations. Caller cannot choose or overwrite the computed ID.
namespace_and_identity.blob_identity: Preserve ArtifactStore SHA-256(payload bytes), ArtifactRef and raw read/write API unchanged. Different semantic roles may share physical bytes but never share one semantic node identity.
namespace_and_identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, no whitespace, finite numbers only, exact typed schema; immutable tuples for ordered structures and sorted unique tuples for set-like structures. Integer clocks reject bool. Exact rational toy values are numerator/positive-denominator pairs in reduced form. Raw payload bytes are hashed as bytes, not arbitrary object repr. Configuration/numerical JSON must be normalized once and retained as immutable canonical bytes. No pickle/eval or arbitrary code execution.
namespace_and_identity.version_change: Changing any dependency, source/receipt version, field bytes, definition, fold, fit membership, transform, target, numerical setting or code/config changes semantic identity even if the displayed value is unchanged. Only harmless ordering of set-like declarations canonicalizes to the same identity.
namespace_and_identity.alias_conflict: A commit key is an immutable alias for one complete canonical commit. Identical retry is idempotent; different manifest under that key fails. Stored semantic ID/payload mismatch is corruption, not a new revision.

node_spec_fields.logical_key: str, included in identity; same name can have multiple new semantic versions
node_spec_fields.unit: explicit str, including dimensionless/count/ticks/points/USD or opaque model-state when appropriate; no implicit unit conversion
node_spec_fields.definition_ref: verified ArtifactRef to retained immutable definition bytes
node_spec_fields.execution: ExecutionIdentity for computed kinds; None only for original source/definition bytes and externally supplied labels/fold metadata with explicit source evidence
node_spec_fields.payload_ref: verified bounded ArtifactRef; schema retains full reconstructible bytes
node_spec_fields.dependencies: tuple[DependencyRef], unique slot names; canonical slot ordering
node_spec_fields.row_evidence: tuple[RowEvidence] for source/measurement/feature/label/prediction data; empty only for non-row state
node_spec_fields.fit_evidence: FitEvidence for fitted transforms/models/calibrators; otherwise None

dependency_ref_fields.slot: nonempty str; one binding per slot
dependency_ref_fields.source_id: computed semantic node ID in the same namespace
dependency_ref_fields.columns: immutable unique column names; empty tuple is an explicit provenance/whole-state edge, never absence of a dependency

stage_rules: All dependencies must exist in the committed closure; no cycles, missing roots, self edges, duplicate slots or silently ignored extra unreferenced nodes. A commit stores exactly the closure of its roots; independently retained roots must be declared explicitly.

label nodes are accessible only through explicit fit_label edges to a fit operation at its declared fit_cut, or through an audit/label view. They cannot appear as a value/fit_feature or inference read.

oof_prediction may be an input to downstream fitting only after the per-row producer OOF gate. final_prediction cannot enter a downstream training feature view, even if a label happens to exclude that row.
Model, calibrator and fitted transform payloads need FitEvidence and explicit fold dependencies; source/measurement and truly fold-independent feature nodes must not carry a hidden fitted dependency.
Empty-column provenance edges still belong to the complete closure and invalidation graph. They are not permission to omit code, calibration or unused-but-read paths.

Compatible units/schema/target are explicitly declared at slot/consumer admission. Heterogeneous units may coexist in a model input matrix when each named column has its own declared unit; no arithmetic or unit compatibility is guessed.

fields.code_ref: verified content-addressed executable source/config package bytes; no arbitrary execute-on-read
fields.numerical_settings_json: immutable canonical JSON bytes with backend_id, precision, rounding, seed (explicit null allowed), thread_count and library/version identifiers
fields.transform_state_refs: immutable ordered named references; all retained and verified
fields.display_name: optional descriptive metadata outside ExecutionIdentity and node hash; retained only in commit/audit labels, never a substitute for content IDs

execution_identity.requirement: Actual served/fit parameter state, input column ordering and transform state must reconcile with the admitted payload and execution identity. Existing BinaryModel/FrequencyModel/CalibratedBinary arithmetic is preserved; an adapter validates its actual serialized state before use.

row_evidence_fields.row_id: immutable exact logical sample/acquisition identity, with dataset/instrument/session namespace retained in schema
row_evidence_fields.observed_at: int64 ns; original economic/source observation clock
row_evidence_fields.input_known_at: int64 ns for source observation availability, never relabeled as actual local receipt unless that is its declared basis
row_evidence_fields.scenario_id: required for named_latency_scenario; no scenario output is labeled actual captured receipt
row_evidence_fields.value_hash: hash of the exact admitted field payload bytes

prediction_evidence_fields.row_id: same exact sample identity as the request
prediction_evidence_fields.target_definition_ref: verified immutable target definition; do not infer target from model or column name
prediction_evidence_fields.target_end: int64 ns original exclusive end, greater than start
prediction_evidence_fields.input_known_at: derived maximum of admitted required input/effect clocks, <= decision_cut for external input evidence
prediction_evidence_fields.mode: OOF or final, consistent with node kind

row_clock_and_target_contract.admission: External observations must be known and valid at decision_cut and observed_at<=decision_cut. Derived same-cut inputs may complete after cut but must be available by assembled_at, retain the same frozen decision_cut and prove all external dependencies were known by that cut. Published known_at=max(input_known_at,actual_completion_at); no extra modeled compute charge is added. Inference is unavailable at or after min(original target_end, inherited valid_until).
row_clock_and_target_contract.historical_audit: Explicit audit access retains old immutable commits/rows after expiry; audit access never implies live/inference usability. A later receipt, rebuild or revision cannot reset original observation time, decision cut, horizon or validity.
row_clock_and_target_contract.target_matching: Consumer request matches the exact target-definition content identity, output unit, row target_start and target_end at every prediction edge. F11 does not implement new label families; it compares retained target definitions and exact frozen endpoints.

fold_and_fit_evidence.population: Retain a canonical immutable population of typed Sample records with sample ID, whole date group, decision_at, label_known_at, dependency_end and target definition. Reject duplicate IDs, inconsistent group identity and malformed clocks before deriving a fold.
fold_and_fit_evidence.fold: Validate supplied Fold against fresh derivation from retained population and registered fit_at/evaluation interval/embargo/training_start. Direct dataclass construction or restored JSON cannot bypass whole-date, maturity, training-window or purge rules. Bound population and membership counts.

fit_evidence_fields.fit_cut: int64 ns; training labels must be mature by this cut
fit_evidence_fields.actual_fit_completion_at: int64 ns >= fit_cut; fitted state cannot be served before actual completion
fit_evidence_fields.training_sample_ids: exact immutable set derived from the validated fold, not a caller-empty assertion
fit_evidence_fields.training_label_refs: retained labels for training rows only
fit_evidence_fields.actual_training_read_manifests: sealed per-row actual reads; training-only transformations use only these values
fit_evidence_fields.upstream_fold_routes: immutable predeclared source-ID-to-fold bindings from an admitted run/fold contract, not inferred from arbitrary supplied artifact objects

fold_and_fit_evidence.oof_gate: For the requested row/sample/date group, traverse every model/scaler/calibrator ancestor; require valid retained fit/population evidence, permitted fold route, fitted completion<=prediction decision_cut and sample/date exclusion. Verify every training label/feature and target dependency. Reject missing closure, final-fit substitution, same-date leakage and future fitted ancestor.
fold_and_fit_evidence.fixed_population_suffix_rule: Future input/label VALUE changes within a fixed registered population cannot change prior fitted parameters or original historical views. Adding/removing members, changing target definitions or registered split metadata intentionally creates a new cohort/fold identity; do not mislabel it the same experiment.

actual_read_audit.configuration: Immutable namespace, declared slots/column order, required columns, optional columns/reasons, decision_cut, assembled_at, intended purpose, fold route and target request. No assignment, deletion or nested mutation changes admitted configuration.
actual_read_audit.input_source: A read receives a verified committed semantic node/row/column binding, not an untyped arbitrary value labeled with a convenient version. Source bytes, field payload hash, source/receipt identity and unit/schema are checked.
operations: read(column) returns only the admitted exact bytes and records the node/row/column/value/source/receipt/clock/fit closure used.
omit_optional(column,reason) records an explicit permitted omission; required columns cannot be converted to optional or silently skipped.

seal() requires every registered required column to have been actually read; rejects undeclared reads, label/final-fit leakage, future/stale/mismatched target/fold/unit/schema and conflicting duplicate reads; returns immutable ReadManifest.
Repeated identical read is idempotent for the manifest. A declared optional field actually read is retained, including an input multiplied by zero or used only on a diagnostic path.
ReadManifest is reconciled against the actual served/fitted model input order and transform state; a retained report-only feature does not count as model input.
actual_read_audit.boundary: The sanctioned reader/adapter records actual calls through its API. It does not claim to intercept arbitrary Python, filesystem reads or third-party native models. Such callers remain uncertified until instrumented and reconciled.

store_commit_restore.configuration: SemanticArtifactStore(root, namespace, limits) fixes namespace/format/limits in one immutable canonical configuration marker. Reopen with changed configuration fails; public configuration is read-only. A dedicated semantic root uses its own ArtifactStore subdirectory and does not mutate existing generic evidence stores.
store_commit_restore.commit_success: Validate the complete bounded proposed closure, typed role/fit/read evidence, all referenced payload/definition/code bytes, and exact root membership before a successful commit pointer can become visible. Stage immutable blobs and canonical manifest, fsync them, then atomically publish one non-overwriting key pointer through the existing publication primitive.
store_commit_restore.pointer_identity: Pointer path is derived from a hash of the commit key, never raw path components. Pointer content includes commit key, namespace/configuration identity and manifest reference. No latest/stale fallback: callers name an exact commit key/reference.
store_commit_restore.read_and_restore: Resolve only through a valid committed pointer. Verify pointer/configuration/manifest/content IDs, declared sizes and canonical serialization; bound bytes before reading; validate complete closure and typed admission again before returning any consumer value. Existing generic ArtifactStore.read remains unchanged.
store_commit_restore.idempotence: Identical same-key canonical success is idempotent after restart and racing writers. Different content under the same key raises ContractError; stored byte/hash/config/pointer corruption raises IntegrityError.
store_commit_restore.failed_attempts: Failed/interrupted run records are separate immutable audit artifacts linked to TrialRegistry attempt IDs and partial blob references; they are never successful semantic commit roots. A still-running process-death attempt stays unresolved until the supervisor records interruption, charging unknown use by reservation rather than zero.
store_commit_restore.process_death: A child process forcibly exits after fsynced blobs/manifest but before final pointer: restart has no usable new commit. It may leave orphaned staging bytes. A child exits immediately after pointer publication: restart sees the complete valid commit and retry is idempotent. No external exactly-once claim.
store_commit_restore.cleanup_and_bounds: Orphaned/generated bytes count toward finite storage accounting; this batch never silently deletes evidence or original sources. No automatic stale-cache reuse or automatic cleanup. A separate explicit retention policy would be required to remove proven obsolete generated artifacts.

invalidation_and_rebuild.input: Old committed closure plus a validated proposed mapping of logical node keys to new semantic specs, with changed source/definition/target/fold/calibrator/code/config seeds declared explicitly.
invalidation_and_rebuild.closure_algorithm: For this finite immutable DAG, compute exact transitive closure/topological order and reverse adjacency; affected set contains each changed seed and its descendants, including explicit empty-column provenance edges. Reject missing/unreachable/cyclic declarations. Reusable nodes retain exact semantic IDs only when all own content and dependency IDs are unchanged.
invalidation_and_rebuild.comparison: Independent primitive-dictionary full traversal/recompute for every root versus indexed reverse-adjacency invalidation and affected-only recompute on the same declared finite toy graph. Full rebuild is the reference; implementation does not obtain expected outputs from its own closure/plan.
invalidation_and_rebuild.metrics: Retain source reads, arithmetic operations, validated nodes/edges, payload and manifest bytes, reused/rebuilt IDs, full construction/restore work and actual toy wall/CPU/RSS when executed. Do not call validation/build costs zero or infer native large-cohort performance from a toy.
invalidation_and_rebuild.column_ownership: Changes propagate through declared ownership/actual-read slots. All reads remain provenance even if their numeric effect cancels. Fold-independent measurements can be reused across new fitted folds; fitted transforms cannot cross folds without an explicit validated route.

errors_and_limits.malformed_or_forbidden: ContractError; malformed typed declarations, namespace/role/fold/target mismatch, cycle, duplicate/conflicting ID/key, omitted actual reads, bounds and mutable constructor inputs
errors_and_limits.immutable_assignment: AttributeError (including FrozenInstanceError) for assignment/deletion of immutable record/configuration fields; bytes item mutation is TypeError. A detached decoded copy may be edited but cannot change retained state.
errors_and_limits.unavailable: DependencyUnavailable; absent successful commit, missing required original artifact/input, failed/interrupted run, expired/unavailable inference. Missing dependencies supplied in an otherwise purported complete declaration are ContractError; absent committed bytes are unavailable unless an existing referenced file is corrupt.
errors_and_limits.corruption: IntegrityError; existing committed bytes/size/hash/canonical envelope/pointer/configuration disagree
errors_and_limits.depth_convention: Number of nodes on the longest root-to-source path; source-only node depth1. All ceilings are inclusive.
errors_and_limits.storage_counting: Unique content blob bytes, including staged/orphaned blobs, plus committed manifests/pointers/configuration are reported separately; max_store_blob_bytes bounds unique blob payload bytes. max_manifest_bytes separately bounds each encoded commit; max_commits counts successful pointers. No partial success if any bound would be exceeded.

proposed_public_api.name: ExecutionIdentity / DependencyRef / RowEvidence / FitEvidence / PredictionEvidence / SemanticNodeSpec
proposed_public_api.contract: Validate all scalar/container/role/clock constraints; derive canonical semantic node identity from all admitted content. No constructor accepts an arbitrary ID that overrides computed identity.

proposed_public_api.name: validate_fold_evidence(population, fold, declared_routes) -> ValidatedFoldEvidence
proposed_public_api.contract: Re-derive exact grouped chronological fold from retained typed population and compare every membership/purge/boundary; retain population and declaration identities.

proposed_public_api.name: validate_closure(roots, node_specs, verified_payloads, configuration) -> ClosureManifest
proposed_public_api.contract: Validate exact transitive membership, sorted deterministic topological order, roles/slots, referenced content, clocks and fitted/read evidence; reject unreferenced extras unless explicitly declared roots.

proposed_public_api.name: SemanticArtifactStore.commit(commit_key, roots, staged_nodes) -> CommitRef
proposed_public_api.contract: One success pointer after complete validation and durable staging. Same-key identical content idempotent; conflicting content rejected. Commit key and returned reference never claim model efficacy.

proposed_public_api.name: SemanticArtifactStore.read_commit(commit_key) -> VerifiedCommit
proposed_public_api.contract: Re-validate committed configuration, bytes, hashes, complete closure and sizes before returning any node; never discover a substitute latest cache.

proposed_public_api.name: SemanticArtifactStore.resolve(commit_ref, node_id, request) -> AdmittedNode
proposed_public_api.contract: Require node membership and matching namespace/purpose/target/clock/fold; explicit audit mode differs from input/OOF/final inference views.

proposed_public_api.name: ReadSession(...).read(column) / omit_optional(column,reason) / seal()
proposed_public_api.kind: bounded actual-read recorder with immutable configuration
proposed_public_api.contract: Read only verified committed row/column bindings, reconcile required/optional declaration and actual reads, and seal an immutable manifest used by fit/prediction admission.

proposed_public_api.name: validate_oof_producer(request, producer_id, verified_commit, declared_fold_routes) -> ProducerGate
proposed_public_api.contract: Traverse retained fit/scaler/calibrator ancestry, enforce role and exact sample/date/target/fold/fit-clock exclusion; no self-authorized fold route.

proposed_public_api.name: plan_rebuild(previous_commit, proposed_specs, changed_keys) -> RebuildPlan
proposed_public_api.contract: Return exact rebuilt/reused identities and causal invalidation paths; no predictor execution or learned routing.

proposed_public_api.name: Model/InputAudit/Fold/runtime binding adapters
proposed_public_api.contract: Preserve existing ArtifactStore, model algorithms, fold API and generic cache helpers; extend/wrap typed validation and actual-read recording where required. Bind actual model/transform/calibrator payload state to admitted semantic identity before use. Unadapted callers remain outside F11 certification.

preserve: src/trading_research/operations/artifacts.py raw API and content store semantics
existing trial/ledger/partition/cohort stores and registered public tests
all predictor numerical algorithms and registered source/planning/original files
proposed_file_scope.ownership: F11 implementation owner is /root/f04_batch_review after explicit root registration/release. Shared runtime/ports.py and verify.py are owned by root. All four foundation registrations must precede shared-source edits. This draft authorizes no implementation.

comparison_stages.definition: Existing descriptive/flat cache keys, per-blob atomic publication and manually supplied fit/input lineage; retain current behavior as a limited baseline without granting absent semantic closure.
Independent primitive dictionaries/tuples reconstruct and validate every required closure, actual-read and OOF relation from scratch; explicit role/clock/target/fold checks and full rebuild.

Typed immutable bounded semantic DAG and atomic committed manifests, indexed reverse adjacency and affected-only rebuild. Same finite source inputs, errors, output values, decisions and provenance as the independent full reference.

design.reference_independence: references/artifact_graph_literal.py may use only standard-library JSON/hash/arithmetic on primitive fixture dictionaries; it must not import implementation record constructors, closure/store/audit/gate helpers or obtain expected values by running candidate code. Frozen JSON literal values and alias-set expectations are authored independently. A small separate reference byte-store simulator can model commit visibility, while actual filesystem/process-death behavior is tested against the real store.

case_mapping.name: Typed namespace and immutable canonical identity
Equal bytes remain separate label OOF and final roles
Publication completion and original expiry
Actual required and optional reads
Late census and revised source preserve old prefix
Exact stage and ancestral closure
Fold membership derives from whole-date population
OOF rejects hidden ancestor training exposure
Exact target units and endpoints
OOF versus final and predeclared cross-fold route
Training-only normalization and fit clock
All execution dependencies participate in identity
Equal-valued new source version invalidates dependents
New calibration cohort reuses independent fitted base
Hidden reads and empty-column provenance edges
Actual model and transform payload attestation
Immutable checkpoint state and configuration restore
Atomic commit and real process death boundaries
Manifest-only reconstruction and explicit absence
Independent full versus targeted rebuild arithmetic
Inclusive finite bounds with no partial state or eviction
Numerical tolerance differs from decision equivalence
Failed and interrupted runs cannot supply artifact inputs
Snapshot and velocity retain separate provenance

unclosed_gates: All real/native large-cohort data access, private inputs and externally captured receipt streams remain separately authorized/acquired dependencies.
No predictor/model fitting, learned routing, chronological calibration performance, held-out forecast/economic gain, all-indicator implementation or E0–E5 policy run occurs in this family.
F11 gates can test synthetic fold/OOF ancestry without certifying real chronological cohorts or unseen future periods.
All unrelated uninstrumented third-party/native feature reads remain outside actual-read certification until separately integrated.
Full production storage concurrency, scale/compression, backend performance and explicit obsolete-cache retention policy remain separate measured comparisons.
Missing source replies/exports and DRF excluded archive details remain unavailable; no historical numerical claims adopted.
No provider connection, purchase, live velocity reconstruction or staleness policy is added; EXT-031 is a stored-event provenance fixture.
design.validation_workflow: Root reviews these drafts, freezes final protocol/golden/design/source hashes with the registrar, then authorizes implementation. Complete static review of implementation/reference/tests and direct callers precedes one consolidated repair and the supervised registered suite. No pre-registration source imports, compilation or test/model/market runs. Failed attempts retained; no unregistered iterative searches.

proposed_run_ceiling_pending_root.accounting: Root may set a combined family protocol before freeze. Shared worker use is recorded once physically and conservatively charged to every participating family; no independent F11-only search outside that accounting.

existing_runtime_port_policy: F11.FROZEN retains FrozenArtifacts.v1 and fields models/transforms/calibrators/training_closure. New typed model and resolver adapters verify the stored closure before serving; unadapted callers gain no implied certification. New offline F11.AUDIT declaration has no automatic consumer activation.
